labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Tumor must be refractory to or have progressed following prior treatment and have no satisfactory alternative treatment options.
Have an Eastern Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.

labels.note: Phase 1 needs no satisfactory alternative, but an approved next-generation TRK inhibitor remains (run 13 'all' rule); phase 2 groups are PDAC, NSCLC and breast only.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Documented pathogenic CKIT activating mutation (Cohort 1) OR pathogenic PDGFRA activating mutation (Cohort 2)
Cohorts 1 and 2: Patient has a locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor and has progressed on appropriate standard therapy

labels.note: Non-GIST sarcoma allowed; KIT/PDGFRA status not reported (only NTRK fusion stated).

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Patients with a biopsy-confirmed recurrent or metastatic sarcoma for which surgery is indicated as a standard of care.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of =< 2

labels.note: Metastatic sarcoma; whether metastasectomy is indicated for the growing lung nodules is not stated.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: History of or current central nervous system metastases.
iii. Arm C - Sarcoma. Participants must have received no more than three lines of prior anti-cancer therapies.
